ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 15 November 2022, effective 1 March 2023; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration, as amended; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP implementing the Law on Investment; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT on enterprise registration; and AML/CFT implementing guidance issued by the State Bank of Viet Nam. Beneficial-owner threshold is 25% of charter capital or effective control. Viet Nam does not maintain a publicly searchable UBO register; beneficial-owner data is retained by the reporting enterprise and made available to competent national authorities upon lawful request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / business registration certificate of each foreign corporate investor or ultimate parent entity (consular legalization required as Viet Nam is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent corporate registrar of the investor's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity document of every direct shareholder, indirect shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner engaged in the single-family-office structure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport / national ID issuing authority of the respective nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution, shareholders' resolution, or equivalent corporate approval authorizing establishment of the Vietnamese LLC and commitment of investment capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or shareholders' meeting of the foreign corporate investor

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Vietnamese incorporation agent / lead counsel, including UBO piercing authorization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized signatory of the foreign investor or ultimate beneficial owner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth file, including bank references, asset statements, and tax-clearance certificates where applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed banks, custodians, tax authorities, or independent financial advisers in the family's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK/HM Treasury Consolidated List, and domestic Vietnamese watchlists maintained by the Ministry of Public Security and the State Bank of Viet Nam. All direct and indirect beneficial owners, directors, authorized signatories, and family-office beneficiaries identified by the UBO-piercing process must be screened. Politically Exposed Persons trigger mandatory enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, senior-management approval, and transaction monitoring. The screening protocol follows FATF standards and Articles 11–14 of the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; administered through the Business Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered LLC name must be composed in the Vietnamese alphabet and must be pronounceable in Vietnamese. A parallel foreign-language name may be registered only as a translation or transliteration of the Vietnamese proper name and cannot replace the Vietnamese name in the Enterprise Registration Certificate. Digits and symbols are permitted only where they form part of a continuous proper name in a manner recognized by the National Business Registration Portal. Rejected names include those that are identical or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise name in the National Enterprise Registration Database.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any name identical or confusingly similar to an enterprise already registered in the National Enterprise Registration Database
Names of Vietnamese state agencies, ministries, provinces, districts, communes, and cities without prior consent (e.g., Công an, Quân đội, Bộ, Sở, Tỉnh, Huyện, Xã, Thành phố)
Political and social-political organization names (e.g., Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam, Mặt trận Tổ quốc Việt Nam, Công đoàn Việt Nam)
Judicial and prosecutorial designations (e.g., Tòa án, Viện Kiểm sát) and public-security designations

Tokens implying licensed regulated activities such as banking, financial services, securities, insurance, lottery, or casino operations where the enterprise does not hold the corresponding statutory license
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: After submission of the name-clearance request through the National Business Registration Portal, the Business Registration Office must, within 3 working days, issue the approval or a written refusal stating the legal ground for the name conflict. If the proposed LLC name is refused, the applicant may submit a corrected name application through the same portal. The applicant may also file a first-instance administrative complaint with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of the refusal, followed by a second-instance complaint with the Ministry of Planning and Investment, and ultimately judicial review before an administrative court under the Law on Administrative Procedures. A name clearance that has been accepted will lapse if the LLC incorporation is not completed within 30 days, in which event a fresh name-check application must be made.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual address without physical business substance is not permissible for LLC registration. Viet Nam requires a physical registered head-office address within the province of registration. A serviced office, co-working space, or property-management address is acceptable only where there is an actual lease or ownership right, physical desk/meeting space, access to corporate records, and a place where service of process and statutory notices can be effectively received. The registered office must be maintained and any change must be filed with the Business Registration Office within statutory deadlines.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high for a foreign-invested LLC in a private investment holding structure; estimated at 35% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Department of Planning and Investment, tax authority, or police administrative authority within the first 12 months of operation. The likelihood increases if the registered office is shared or does not demonstrate real commercial substance on a follow-up verification.
