incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020, effective 1 January 2021 (Articles 27-31 on Enterprise Registration; Articles 74-88 on Single-Member Limited Liability Companies); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 37-39 on Investment Registration Certificate procedure for foreign investors); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Forms I-1, I-2, I-5); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on investment procedures; and Circular No. 05/2014/TT-NHNN as amended on Indirect Investment Capital Accounts.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Agency for Business Registration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment operating the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn); the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) is the locally competent registry authority issuing the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) in the province where the registered office is situated.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giay de nghi dang ky doanh nghiep) submitted together with the Investment Project Proposal (De xuat du an dau tu), leading to the issuance of the Investment Registration Certificate (Giay chung nhan dang ky dau tu) and the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giay chung nhan dang ky doanh nghiep); the ERC is the constitutive incorporation instrument of the limited liability company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under the Law on Enterprises 2020 for a single-member limited liability company engaged in passive family investment holding. The foreign investor must demonstrate financial capability equivalent to the committed charter capital in the IRC dossier under Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP. The charter capital must be fully contributed within ninety (90) days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. No statutory escrow account or mandatory capital deposit account is required by incorporation law, but the contributed capital must be remitted into a legally licensed commercial bank account in Viet Nam; a separate Indirect Investment Capital Account (IICA) is required for inward remittances destined for securities and custody transactions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER ON SUBSCRIPTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL, ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE, ADOPTION OF THE COMPANY CHARTER AND APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS OF [VIETNAM SINGLE FAMILY HOLDING] SINGLE-MEMBER LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (RESOLUTION NO. 01/2025/SFO)

PURSUANT TO: The Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP; and the draft Company Charter of [VIETNAM SINGLE FAMILY HOLDING] Single-Member Limited Liability Company (the 'Company').

WHEREAS: The Sole Member is the sole owner of the entire charter capital of the Company and intends to incorporate the Company as a foreign-invested single-member limited liability company in the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam for the lawful purpose of private investment holding and the administration of the high-net-worth family's financial assets, such activity being limited to the family's own assets and not constituting the provision of investment management services to third parties;

NOW, THEREFORE, the Sole Member hereby resolves and adopts the following resolutions:

1. SUBSCRIPTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL: The Sole Member hereby subscribes to and irrevocably commits to contribute the entire charter capital of the Company in the amount of VND [•] (in words: ...), in the form of cash and/or lawful assets, such contribution to be made in full within ninety (90) days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate in accordance with Article 75 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. The capital contribution obligation shall be satisfied by transfer to the Company's capital contribution account maintained with a lawfully licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam.

2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office of the Company shall be situated at [Full address, Ward, Commune, District, Province/City, Viet Nam], which shall constitute the headquarters and principal place of administration of the Company for all legal and tax purposes. The Sole Member authorizes the General Director to execute and register the lease agreement or other legal instrument of location and to undertake all actions necessary to perfect the Company's legal address.

3. ADOPTION OF THE COMPANY CHARTER: The Company Charter in the form submitted to the Department of Planning and Investment is hereby approved and adopted, including provisions on the name, registered office, business lines, charter capital, organization and management of the single-member company, the legal representative, and the rights and obligations of the Sole Member, all in strict compliance with Articles 74-88 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.

4. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: (a) [Name of individual, passport number, nationality, residential address] is hereby appointed as Chairperson of the Members' Council of the Company, with full authority to chair meetings and to represent the Sole Member for all corporate governance matters; (b) [Name of individual, passport number, nationality, residential address] is hereby appointed as General Director of the Company, who shall also serve as the legal representative of the Company, with full power to sign all documents, contracts, bank forms, tax filings, and registration applications on behalf of the Company, to open bank accounts including the Indirect Investment Capital Account, to hire employees, and to execute all instruments necessary for the incorporation, licensing, and operation of the Company.

5. AUTHORIZATION FOR INCORPORATION PROCEEDINGS: The Commercial Director and/or legal counsel of the Sole Member are hereby authorized to prepare, notarize, legalize, translate, and submit all dossiers to the Department of Planning and Investment, the Ministry of Planning and Investment, tax authorities, banking institutions, and any other regulatory authority, to collect the Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate, to receive any written queries, and to remediate any statutory deficiencies in the incorporation dossiers.

6. RATIFICATION OF ACTS: All acts lawfully performed prior to the date of this Resolution with respect to the incorporation of the Company, including the execution of lease memoranda, the opening of preliminary bank accounts, and the engagement of professional advisers, are hereby ratified and approved.

7. EFFECTIVE DATE: This Resolution is effective as of the date of execution and shall continue in full force and effect until amended or superseded by a subsequent resolution of the Sole Member.

Dated this [•] day of [month], [year].

SIGNED: _______________________ (Sole Member) [If the sole member is a corporation, sign by authorized representative with accompanying authorization resolution.]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Dossier Legalization, Notarization and Translation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate in the investor's jurisdiction (for consular legalization), and notary public offices recognized by the provincial Department of Justice of the SFO's intended province in Viet Nam; the Consular Legalization Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for any certified copies executed in Viet Nam.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor must prepare the constituent and identity documents of the ultimate shareholder (if a corporate entity) and the individual officers. All documents issued outside Viet Nam must be legalized by a Vietnamese consular mission, then translated into Vietnamese by a certified translator, and the Vietnamese translations must be notarized. The proposed registered office address must be secured by a memorandum of lease, a certified copy of the certificate of land use rights and house ownership of the lessor, and, where the lessor is a commercial service office provider, a copy of the service provider's ERC. Financial capability evidence, being the immediate preceding year's audited financial statements of the corporate investor or a bank confirmation of available funds of the individual investor, must be prepared in accordance with Form A.12 of Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP. This step is performed before any filing to the DPI.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the passport or national identity card of the individual foreign investor and of each proposed officer and legal representative.
Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and memorandum/articles of association of the corporate investor, if the sole member is an entity.
Consular legalization certificate issued by the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate for each foreign-origin document.
Certified Vietnamese translations and notarized copies of all foreign-origin documents.
Memorandum of lease or conditional lease undertaking for the registered office, together with the lessor's land and house ownership documents.
Financial capability report for the committed charter capital (Form A.12, Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP).
Power of attorney authorizing the local incorporator or law firm to execute and submit the registration dossiers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary refuses certification or the consulate rejects legalization on account of a defective or expired document, the applicant shall cure by obtaining a reissued document, a supplementary apostille where the jurisdiction permits, or a newly executed translation; administrative reconsideration may be requested from the Consular Legalization Office within 30 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) through the National Investment Information System (invest.gov.vn) and the one-stop-shop administrative window of the provincial People's Committee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The investor must submit a written investment project proposal in the mandatory form, together with the supporting dossiers, applying for an IRC for a foreign-invested single-member limited liability company whose business scope is private investment holding and family asset administration under ISIC 6430. The proposal must explicitly declare that the company will only manage the family's own assets and will not provide asset management services to the public or third-party clients, thereby confirming that the activity is not a conditional investment sector under the Law on Investment 2020 and does not require a securities license. The DPI will notify the investor within 5 working days if the dossier is incomplete; once complete, the DPI issues the IRC within 15 working days. If the investment is within a sector subject to investment policy approval, the timeline is extended to 25 working days, but passive family holding is outside such list.
required_dossiers: Application for the Investment Registration Certificate in the form prescribed by Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP.
Investment project proposal setting out the business objectives, scale, charter capital, and intended operational activities of the Single Family Office.
Certified copy of the investor's passport or incorporation document.
Financial capability report evidencing the investor's ability to contribute the committed charter capital.
Memorandum of lease or legal confirmation of the registered office address.
Statement confirming that the SFO will not engage in activities reserved for licensed securities/asset management institutions.
Power of attorney to the authorized representative for the submission of the IRC dossier.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for amendment or supplementation, the investor must cure within the stated period, typically 10 working days; if the DPI unlawfully refuses to issue the IRC, the investor may file a complaint with the Chairperson of the provincial People's Committee or bring an administrative action under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 and the Law on Administrative Procedures; alternatively, the investor may seek written guidance of the Ministry of Planning and Investment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Issuance of the LLC Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) or the DPI's one-stop-shop counter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately upon receipt of the IRC, the investor must file the enterprise registration dossier for a single-member limited liability company. The application must name the company in Vietnamese, identify the business line under the Vietnamese Business Code corresponding to ISIC 6430 (financial investment holding/activities of head offices and investment management of own assets), appoint the Chairperson of the Members' Council and the General Director/legal representative, and declare the registered office. The DPI is required to issue the ERC within 3 working days from the date of receipt of a complete dossier. Issuance of the ERC operates simultaneously as tax registration with the General Department of Taxation, automatically triggering the assignment of the enterprise's tax identification number. Upon issuance, the company acquires legal personality and may lawfully commence operational activities subject to any post-incorporation conditions.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration for a single-member limited liability company (Form I-1, Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP).
Company Charter approved by the Sole Member, executed in conformity with Article 24 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.
List of legal representatives of the company (Form I-5, Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP).
Certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate.
Certified copies of the identity documents of the Sole Member and the proposed Chairperson and General Director.
Certified copy of the office lease agreement and the lessor's ownership certificate.
Power of attorney authorizing the filing of the ERC application if submitted by a third party.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI rejects the dossier, it must issue a written notice stating the specific deficiencies; the applicant must complete correction and resubmit. The rejection may be appealed to the Director of the provincial DPI and then to the Minister of Planning and Investment; the applicant may also challenge the decision in the provincial administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Creation and Seal Sample Announcement, Capital Contribution and Bank Account Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal for the seal sample announcement; licensed commercial banks in Viet Nam for the capital contribution account and the Indirect Investment Capital Account (IICA); the State Bank of Viet Nam as the governing monetary authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, the General Director shall procure the physical company seal on behalf of the company and announce the seal sample through the online seal sample announcement service of the National Business Registration Portal; the announcement is free of charge and takes effect upon posting. The company shall open a capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam, and the Sole Member shall remit the committed charter capital within the statutory 90-day window. Because the SFO will engage in securities purchases and custody under the family's private banking and custody payment rails, the company must additionally open an Indirect Investment Capital Account (IICA) at a licensed bank authorized by the State Bank under Circular No. 05/2014/TT-NHNN; all inward remittances from abroad destined for investment in Vietnamese securities and other capital-market instruments must pass through the IICA. The bank will conduct enhanced customer due diligence appropriate to the Medium-Risk AML classification, requiring disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners, source of funds, and the family relationship among investors.
required_dossiers: Announcement of seal sample form submitted via the National Business Registration Portal, attaching a high-resolution image of the seal.
Enterprise Registration Certificate and tax identification number confirmation.
Application form for opening a capital contribution account at the chosen commercial bank.

Application form for opening an Indirect Investment Capital Account (IICA) under Circular No. 05/2014/TT-NHNN, including AML/KYC declarations of the company, the sole member, and the ultimate beneficial owners.
Copies of the passport of the General Director/legal representative and his/her appointment resolution.
The Company Charter and certificate of seal announcement.
Bank-confirmed source-of-funds documentation for the charter capital remittance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal announcement is rejected, the company must correct the uploaded image and resubmit; if a bank refuses to open the IICA because of incomplete beneficial ownership documentation, the company shall supply a sworn declaration of the family's asset ownership structure and, if necessary, obtain a written legal opinion confirming the non-public nature of the investment activity; disputes with the bank may be escalated to the State Bank's branch supervision division.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, License Fee Declaration, Electronic Invoicing and Tax Administration Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation through the National Tax Portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) and the provincial Tax Sub-Department where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The enterprise tax code is automatically issued upon the ERC, but the company must complete supplementary tax registration by declaring additional tax information through the e-tax portal within the prescribed period. The company must file the license fee (mon bai) declaration, and the first year of operation after incorporation is exempt from the license fee; subsequent years carry a fee of VND 3,000,000 annually for companies with charter capital above VND 2 billion, or VND 2,000,000 if below. The company must register for electronic tax payment, sign an e-tax agreement with a participating commercial bank, register its authorized tax account, and apply to the tax authority for the issuance and use of electronic invoices; an electronic invoice template must be registered before any invoicing activity. Since the SFO will derive income from dividends, interest, and capital gains, the company must set up its accounting system in accordance with the enterprise accounting regime (Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC) and file periodic CIT declarations under Law No. 71/2024/QH15, effective 2025, at the standard 20% CIT rate, with passive income recognition rules requiring careful tracking of tax-exempt intercompany dividends.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and tax identification number.
Supplementary tax registration declaration (Form 01/DK-TCT) with the identification of the legal representative and tax payment obligations.
License fee declaration (Form 01/LPNMB).
Lease agreement and supporting documents for business location confirmation.
Bank account confirmation, including the IICA account details.
Registration of electronic invoice template.
Authorization documents for tax agents or chief accountant.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax code is not automatically activated, the company may request the provincial DPI to coordinate with the Tax Sub-Department for rectification; if the e-tax registration fails, the General Director must appear in person at the Tax Sub-Department with the ERC and identity documents; actions of the tax authority that result in the denial or suspension of tax registration may be appealed to the Director General of the General Department of Taxation within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Safety, Occupational Safety, Labor Registration and Environmental Compliance Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Fighting and Rescue Police Department (PC07) of the provincial Police; Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA); Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) and the provincial Social Insurance Agency.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing physical operations at the registered office, the company must verify that the office premises are covered by a valid fire safety acceptance (PCCC) certificate or, in the case of a location within a licensed commercial office building, obtain the building owner's certified copy of the fire safety acceptance; new fit-out works require a separate PCCC design appraisal and acceptance from the PC07 under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP. The company must comply with workplace regulations by establishing the internal labor regulations, registering a labor roster with DOLISA, and completing social insurance and health insurance registration for every employee within 30 days of the first hire. Environmental compliance for a passive-investment office is minimal: the project falls under the exemption category of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP, and the company shall maintain waste collection contracts with licensed waste service providers and, if applicable, a domestic wastewater discharge arrangement compliant with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT; the backup generator, if installed, must meet QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT emission thresholds and noise standards.
required_dossiers: Fire safety acceptance certificate (PCCC) covering the office premises or a certified copy held by the building owner.
PCCC fit-out dossier, including design drawings, approval letter, and acceptance certificate if renovations were required.
Internal labor regulation dossier filed with DOLISA.
Labor roster declaration (Form 01/PLII) submitted to DOLISA upon first recruitment.
Social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance registration dossiers submitted to the provincial Social Insurance Agency.
Waste collection service agreement with a licensed environmental service company.
Environmental registration exemption confirmation or, where applicable, environmental registration dossier with the DONRE.
Occupational safety assessment reports where any employees are involved in physical asset management or banking-custody activities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PC07 identifies deficiencies in fire safety systems, the company must implement a written remediation plan approved by the PC07 within the prescribed period and request re-inspection; for labor and social insurance registration defects, the company must file corrected declarations and pay any statutory late-payment interest; environmental non-compliance is cured by submitting an amended registration and implementing the compliance plan; refusal or inaction by the authorities may be appealed to the provincial People's Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable. The private investment holding and single-family-office activity under ISIC 6430/NAICS 525920 is not a conditional business line under the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 and is not subject to industrial licensing by the Ministry of Industry and Trade. If, however, the SFO were to broaden its scope to provide investment management services to third parties or to establish/operate a securities fund, it would fall within the conditional business of securities and fund management and would require the prior grant of a Securities Business License or Fund Management Company License from the State Securities Commission of Viet Nam.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the passive family-investment holding model. The Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate are together the sole constitutive authorizations required. No separate operating, manufacturing, or industrial permit is mandated for a non-manufacturing administrative office; only the post-incorporation administrative clearances (fire safety, tax, labor, IICA bank account) are compulsory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) at the central level and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) at the local level
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from Full EIA Report and from mandatory environmental registration. Administrative office premises for a passive financial holding company are classified as Group IV projects under Appendix II of Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP and consequently require neither an Environmental Impact Assessment Report nor an Environmental Registration Certificate. The company should, nevertheless, obtain a written confirmation of exemption from the provincial DONRE or, in the alternative, submit a simplified environmental registration declaration if the lessor's building-level environmental permits so require.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Although no EIA is required, the office operations must respect the applicable technical standards: (i) domestic/domestic-like wastewater discharged into the municipal system must satisfy QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT or the sewerage authority's binding acceptance limits; (ii) any auxiliary electricity generator must meet the emission thresholds of QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT for industrial emissions and QCVN 06:2009/BTNMT for ambient air quality; (iii) solid waste, including electronic waste from office equipment, must be collected and transported by an entity holding the appropriate environmental permit, with chain-of-custody records retained; and (iv) in case the Company's investment activities later finance real estate or industrial facilities, such underlying projects must independently comply with the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decrees No. 08/2022/ND-CP and No. 05/2025/ND-CP, as applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification: the registered office must be covered by a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (Van ban chap nhan ket qua nghiem thu ve phong chay va chua chay) issued by the Fire Prevention and Fighting and Rescue Police Department (PC07) under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP; where the company leases space in an already-certified office building, it must obtain a certified copy of the building's acceptance certificate and, for any internal fit-out affecting escape routes or fire systems, a supplementary appraisal and acceptance. Structural load clearance: the physical handling and custody of assets are limited to quiet-office and safe-deposit functions; the lessor must provide the structural conformity certificate of the building with the intended use as offices, and the company must not alter the structural load-bearing elements without a civil engineer's certification. Workplace/occupational clearance: the General Director must adopt an internal labor regulation under Article 118 of the Labour Code No. 45/2019/QH13, submit a labor roster to the Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs, complete the occupational safety and health risk assessment, appoint an occupational safety officer where there are five or more employees, register the employees with the provincial Social Insurance Agency within 30 days of commencement of employment, and, for employees handling securities custody or private banking wire operations, provide anti-fraud and AML/KYC operational protocols consistent with the State Bank of Viet Nam's AML regulations under the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 14/2022/QH14.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance – National e-Tax Portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; National Business Registration Portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company must first obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI). It then registers its enterprise through the National Business Registration Portal, which issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC). The Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, TIN) is automatically granted by the local tax authority upon ERC approval; the same TIN serves as the VAT registration code. The LLC must file an initial tax registration dossier with supporting corporate legal documents, passports of owners/legal representative, and invested capital charts. TIN issuance generally occurs within 1–3 working days after ERC approval and is delivered through the e-tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (flat 20% CIT; residents taxed on worldwide income; an LLC cannot be a pass-through entity under Vietnam law). Territorial_Scope: tax-resident LLCs are taxed on worldwide income; non-resident owners are taxed only on Vietnamese-source income. Tax_Exempt_Zone: no automatic tax-exempt zone status by registration alone; only licensed Export Processing Enterprises (EPEs) in export-processing, industrial or high-tech zones receive special 0% VAT and preferential CIT regimes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not operate check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch entity elections. Available statutory choices include: (i) election for non-resident contractors to pay withholding tax on gross turnover or on deemed profit rates; (ii) election to apply small- and medium-enterprise CIT incentives if statutory size and revenue thresholds are met; (iii) election to determine deductible expenses under the actual accounting method vs deemed accounting basis for certain foreign contractors; (iv) election between one-off or periodic VAT filing for imported services. No tax-transparency election exists for a domestic LLC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT, Thuế GTGT) under Law No. 106/2016/QH13
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1 billion in annual taxable turnover – VAT registration is mandatory once annual revenue from taxable activities exceeds VND 1 billion; for foreign-invested LLCs, VAT registration is issued together with the TIN at the outset irrespective of the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All taxpayers must use electronic invoices under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular No. 78/2021/TT-BTC. Invoices must be transmitted to the General Department of Taxation's e-invoice system in real time (within 12 hours after issuance) using the e-tax portal API or a service provider's XML/API integration. Invoices require a Tax Authority Code for enterprises; no physical stamping applies. For exports, customs electronic clearance is handled through the Vietnam Automated Cargo and Port Consolidated System (VNACCS/VCIS).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to exports of goods outside Vietnam, sale of goods to export-processing enterprises (EPEs) or into non-tariff zones, offshore services consumed outside Vietnam, and certain international transport and related services. Conditions require the LLC to be VAT-registered, hold a valid export sales contract, issue a compliant electronic invoice, obtain customs export declaration for goods, provide transportation documents evidencing export, and submit proof that the export payment was received from a non-resident by bank wire or L/C into a Vietnamese bank account within 180 days from the customs export clearance date.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Automated Customs Export Declaration – electronic VNACCS/VCIS clearance record
Commercial invoice issued under the electronic invoice system
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill evidencing export
Export sales contract (with Incoterms and payment terms)
Packing list and certificate of origin (if applicable)
Inward remittance certificate / bank SWIFT MT103 / bank credit advice showing receipt of foreign exchange from abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Tax authorities systematically reconcile export declarations, e-invoices, bank receipts, FX repatriation records and customs manifest data. Improper zero-rating claims result in retrospective clawback of input VAT credits, re-imposition of 10% VAT on the denied supply, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, administrative penalties of 1–3 times the evaded amount for tax evasion, customs fines and freezing of export refunds. Criminal liability applies under the Penal Code (No. 100/2015/QH13, as amended) for large-scale tax fraud, smuggling or counterfeiting export documentation, with sentences up to 20 years' imprisonment and vessels/individual asset confiscation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân Hàng Nhà Nước Việt Nam / SBV), exercising dual authority as the national central bank and the Foreign Exchange Administration through its Foreign Exchange Management Department. Regulatory framework: Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 06/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended, Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP, and Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN as amended by Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam operates a managed partial-convertibility regime for the Vietnamese Dong (VND). Current account transactions (goods trade, services, operational remittances, dividends on approved profits) are freely convertible through SBV-licensed banks upon presentation of underlying documentation (sales contracts, customs declarations, invoices, tax clearance). Capital account transactions are subject to strict control: inward direct investment capital requires an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), registration of the capital contribution schedule, and the opening of a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a single licensed commercial bank; intra-group loans require SBV-registered loan agreements; all outbound investments require separate registration. Profit and dividend remittance is permitted annually after audited financial statements, tax finalization, and completion of an annual profit-remittance registration, then executed solely through the DICA; practical hurdles include mandatory risk-based enhanced due diligence, documentary proof of source of funds, and the absence of a fully deliverable offshore VND market for round-tripping.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory surrender ratio for export proceeds in Viet Nam; exporters may retain 100% of export receipts in foreign currency accounts at SBV-licensed credit institutions. However, export proceeds must be repatriated to a licensed bank account in Viet Nam within 90 days from the date of customs clearance/exportation (extendable to 180 days under permitted long-rotation projects and with bank concurrence), and the exporter must submit transport/customs/sale documentation to evidence collection. Any conversion to VND is executed voluntarily at the bank's prevailing interbank rate, subject to the SBV's daily reference rate band; there is no statutory obligation to sell a fixed percentage to the central bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account + Private Banking Mandate

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank (VPBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND-FX Current Account + Private Banking Mandate

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI platforms (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud, Revolut Business) are not licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam and are legally incapable of holding VND, opening corporate accounts on behalf of a Vietnamese-resident LLC, or functioning as the primary clearing rail for a DICA. The only permissible payment-technology channels are SBV-licensed non-bank payment intermediaries (e.g., MoMo, VNPT Epay, Payoo), which are limited to domestic e-wallet scenarios and cannot accept or disburse FDI capital. Using an offshore EMI as a treasury intermediary for the Vietnamese entity would constitute a direct breach of Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN and Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP (administrative sanctions in banking and foreign exchange), carrying fines, suspension of account usage, and potential criminal exposure for the legal representative.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is de facto mandatory for the legal representative (or a specifically mandated senior officer) at the corporate account-opening KYC interview. Remote/video-only onboarding for an inbound-investment LLC classified as Medium-Risk (Enhanced) is not generally available for the DICA product. Where the legal representative is outside Viet Nam, a notarized Power of Attorney with consular legalization, Vietnamese translation, and a board/members' council resolution appointing the local signatory must be produced; the local authorized officer must appear physically with the original passport and company chop (seal). Biometric verification and live interview by the bank's compliance officer are standard for all UBOs and signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity - complex trust, nominee, or offshore SPV layers above the Vietnamese LLC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership chain chart to ultimate natural-person family members; certified passport copies of all UBOs; notarized trust deeds, appointment instruments for trustees/protectors, partnership agreements, and the family office constitutional documents; independent opinion from a licensed Vietnamese law firm confirming legal beneficial ownership and control structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Economic substance deficiency - passive holding with no employees, office, or operating history (shell profile)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Vietnamese office lease with rental-payment evidence; employment contracts for a resident director and finance/accounting personnel with Vietnamese payroll and social-insurance filings; approved Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) evidencing ISIC 6430 scope; investment policy statement and family-office mandate; monthly general ledger and statutory books.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds and source of wealth concerns for the HNW family's capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month global bank statements with notarized translations; sale-and-purchase agreements for real estate, securities, or business exits; inheritance and gift instruments; foreign tax residency certificates and home-jurisdiction tax clearance; letter from a Big-4 auditor or fiduciary documenting the wealth-creation path and each capital tranche.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP exposure, or high-risk jurisdiction linkage in the remitting corridor
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated PEP/sanctions screening results via the bank's compliance systems; documented source and use of funds for each transfer; confirmation that remitting banks are regulated institutions in FATF-compliant jurisdictions; written representations on absence of shell-bank intermediation; negative-news and adverse-media reports documented and archived.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital-contribution schedule mismatch - early or over-contribution to the DICA inconsistent with the registered IRC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital-contribution decision of the Members' Council; amended IRC/ERC reflecting the updated charter capital and timeline; prior written approval from the DICA bank for early contribution; completed SBV transaction-purpose-code declaration matching the registered schedule; board resolution authorizing the wiring details.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The sole compliant route for inbound direct capital is the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) maintained at the selected SBV-licensed commercial bank. Sequence: (1) issuance of the IRC and ERC with registered charter capital and contribution schedule; (2) corporate account opening (DICA plus operational VND/FX accounts); (3) the non-resident family/SPO wires via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from an account in the identical legal name, quoting the correct Vietnamese transaction-purpose code for direct equity investment/loan disbursement, the DICA number, the LLC corporate name, and tax identification number; (4) the bank verifies the remittance against the registered schedule, performs the SBV foreign-exchange reporting, and confirms no third-party offsetting; (5) conversion into VND is executed at the bank's interbank rate within the SBV reference-rate band, with a formal FX-conversion confirmation. No capital contribution may bypass the DICA, and any early or excess contribution requires prior approval and an amended IRC before remittance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements the LLC may use (a) direct irrevocable SWIFT MT103 transfers through the onshore bank for service disbursements, intra-group current items, and operating expenses; (b) documentary collections with full shipping documents; or (c) commercial letters of credit under UCP600 issued by the Vietnamese bank and, where required, confirmed by an international correspondent bank. All outbound disbursements into foreign currency must be routed through the DICA with statutory purpose codes (e.g., dividend/profit remittance, repayment of foreign loans, outbound investment) and accompanied by audited financial statements, tax clearance, board resolutions, and supporting contracts. Securities purchases and custody trade settlements are executed through the Vietnamese Securities Depository (VSD) sub-custody network using VND settlement at the licensed custodian bank in accordance with Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards between the LLC and an SBV-licensed credit institution, with maximum tenor of 365 days and valid only against a genuine underlying current or capital transaction exposure; settled net in VND.
FX swaps executed onshore with the licensed bank, providing simultaneous spot-and-forward conversion for treasury repositioning against qualified DICA-linked inflows/outflows.
Currency swaps and cross-currency interest rate swaps transacted onshore for long-dated foreign-currency assets, intra-group loans, and investment positions duly registered with the SBV.
FX options purchased from SBV-licensed banks to hedge committed trade or financial exposure, with premium payable in VND and documented underlying exposure.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible or legally enforceable as a hedging product for an onshore Vietnamese-resident entity; any offshore NDF exposure constitutes a foreign-exchange-control violation. Acceptable hedging is available only through deliverable onshore products executed via the licensed Vietnamese bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee Return and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: District Tax Sub-Department (Chi cục Thuế) where the head office is located; paid via the national eTax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January of the compliance year; newly established enterprises are exempt in their first year and file from the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid fee; administrative penalty of 1–3 times the under-declared license fee; continued non-payment enables tax-demand enforcement and suspension of invoice issuance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Quyết toán thuế TNDN, Form 03/TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) via the national eTax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar fiscal year, on or before 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month of delay (capped at 30% of the tax due) plus 0.03% per day interest on the outstanding tax; administrative fines of up to VND 25 million for false or incomplete declarations; non-clearance may block certificates of tax completion and administrative deregistration follows in severe cases

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax Finalization Return (Quyết toán thuế TNCN, Form 05/QTT-TNCN) for any officers and employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: District Tax Sub-Department / Provincial Tax Department via the national eTax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar fiscal year, on or before 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 2–5% of the tax payable per month of delay (capped at 30%) plus 0.03% per day interest; failure to withhold triggers additional monthly penalties on unwithheld amounts; responsible directors face administrative fines of up to VND 75 million

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Independent Audit Report (Báo cáo tài chính năm; mandatory for foreign-invested enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department, Department of Planning and Investment (for foreign-invested enterprises), and the provincial Bureau of Statistics / National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar fiscal year, on or before 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of up to VND 20 million for late filing and up to VND 40 million for failure to submit audited accounts of a foreign-invested enterprise; submission of unaudited statements is not accepted and blocks tax finalization and investment compliance clearances

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Activity Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between 1 February and 31 March of the compliance year (statutory annual window)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-submission fine of up to VND 5 million; failure to submit fine of up to VND 20 million; prolonged non-compliance removes the enterprise from the active roster and initiates the administrative strike-off and dissolution procedure

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested enterprises (FIEs) are subject to compulsory independent audit annually regardless of revenue or asset size. Domestic private companies are subject to mandatory audit if they exceed two of three criteria: total assets greater than VND 20 billion, annual revenue greater than VND 20 billion, or average workforce greater than 10 employees. Additional mandatory audits apply to public companies, credit institutions, insurers, securities companies, and state-controlled enterprises.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) implemented under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS is permitted for specified public-interest entities and certain FIEs/consolidated groups under Decision 345/QD-BTC; statutory books must be maintained in Vietnamese Dong and in the Vietnamese language, with supporting vouchers retained in-country.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a public UBO register. Under the Law on Enterprises 2020, the LLC must maintain a continuous register of members/owners; any share transfer or ownership change must be recorded in the register and notified to the Business Registration Office within 10 days. Annually, the Enterprise Activity Report, filed between 1 February and 31 March, attests that the member register accurately reflects current ownership. Under the AML Law 2022, the entity must identify and record beneficial owners for customer-due-diligence purposes where an individual directly or indirectly holds at least 25% of charter capital or exercises control; this record is kept on-premises for inspection, with no separate annual UBO filing to the tax or registration authority.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Owners (Sổ đăng ký thành viên / Sổ đăng ký chủ sở hữu)
Register of Directors and Company Managers (Sổ đăng ký người quản lý doanh nghiệp)
Minutes and Resolution Book of Members' Meetings (Sổ biên bản họp / Sổ nghị quyết)
Register of Capital Contributions (Sổ đăng ký vốn góp)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450–1,200 per year for registered-office administration, corporate secretarial support, and resident agent services in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City, excluding VAT
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000–6,000 per year for a licensed independent audit of a simple investment holding vehicle; consolidated or group structures may exceed the upper bound

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate 20%; preferential rates of 10% for 15 years for qualifying high-tech, large-scale manufacturing, and new-material projects; 15% CIT rate for certain agricultural and supporting-industry projects; High-Tech Enterprise (HTE) incentive of 10% for 15 years; socialization sectors (education, healthcare) at 10%; Small and medium-sized enterprises may access reduced rates and deferrals under applicable laws; tax holidays of 4 years full exemption plus 9 years at 50% reduction for certain new investment projects in eligible sectors and locations; EPE (Export Processing Enterprise) status supports VAT and customs duty relief but does not independently reduce CIT headline rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Form 03/TNDN) filed via the General Department of Taxation's electronic portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn), integrated with the national e-tax filing system (HTKK/Etax Mobile or Etax Desktop software).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization return; quarterly provisional CIT payments are mandatory (Form 01/TNDN or equivalent provisional payment instruction), with annual finalization by the 90th day from the end of the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final CIT return must be submitted no later than the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year (i.e., by March 31 for a calendar-year taxpayer). Quarterly provisional payments are due on the 30th day of the first month of the next quarter; total provisional payments during the year must not be less than 80% of the final annual CIT liability to avoid under-payment penalties and interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number, entity name, address, tax authority, fiscal year, and contact information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-invested LLC must use its Vietnamese Enterprise Registration Code and Tax Identification Number; indicate local legal representative and authorized tax agent if any.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Revenue from goods and services (Doanh thu)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue derived from business activities, including investment holding revenue, dividends received, interest income, securities custody and trading gains, and other operating income, computed under Vietnamese Accounting Standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Vietnamese-source investment income; dividends from domestic companies received by a Vietnamese LLC are generally excluded from taxable revenue at the recipient level only if domestic dividend exemption conditions are met; foreign portfolio and private-equity-derived income must be reported.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Deductible expenses (Chi phí được trừ)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses that satisfy the deductibility conditions: actual incurred, related to production/business, supported by lawful invoices and vouchers, and not listed as non-deductible expenses under Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC and successor regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cap at the statutory limit for management service fees and intercompany charges; no deduction for impaired investments without documented economic substance; no deduction for provisions not specifically permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C – Other income (Thu nhập khác)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains from asset disposals, foreign exchange differences, forgiven debts, penalties, and other non-operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include gains on disposal of equity interests in Vietnamese and offshore targets; observe that capital gains on transfer of shares in a Vietnamese company by a foreign investor are subject to 0.1% of the transfer price (or 20% of net gain at the transferor's election under certain conditions) if the seller is a foreign entity, but a Vietnamese LLC-seller is subject to CIT at the standard rate on the net gain.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D – Tax calculation (Thuế phải nộp)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed CIT: taxable income multiplied by the applicable CIT rate (20% standard or preferential rate), with foreign tax credit, loss carryforward adjustment, and incentives applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply loss carryforward in chronological order for no more than 5 years; provide full documentation for foreign tax credits on double-taxed foreign-source income if any.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E – Prepayments and balance (Tạm nộp và chênh lệch)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly provisional payments already made, tax withheld at source, and any balance due or overpayment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure cumulative quarterly payments meet or exceed 80% of final liability; otherwise apply an underpayment penalty of 0.03% per day on the shortfall.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supporting schedules including tax incentive computation, loss carryforward schedule (Phụ lục 03-9/TNDN), transfer pricing disclosure form (Phụ lục GCNT/03-10/TNDN for related-party transactions), and reconciliation of accounting profit to taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete transfer pricing forms even without intercompany transactions if the entity is a single-family-office investment holding vehicle with cross-border financing, fees, or foreign investment flows; disclose all related-party relationships in the family group.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty tiers under Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14 and Government Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: filing more than 1 day and up to 5 days late: VND 2,000,000 to VND 5,000,000 (or 10% of outstanding tax if no return), depending on the number of cited tax articles; extended delays trigger progressive fines up to VND 15,000,000 plus additional daily interest of 0.03% on unpaid tax amounts, plus potential administrative enforcement via bank account seizure, suspension of invoices, or revocation of business license for repeated non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Vietnamese LLC to its foreign corporate shareholder if the dividend is distributed from after-tax retained earnings and no deemed profit remittance applies; however, a foreign investor that transfers shares realizes capital gains taxed at 0.1% on gross transfer price (or 20% on net capital gains at the seller's election). For branch structures, a remittance of after-tax profits abroad is subject to a 0% remittance tax rate (no separate branch remittance tax), provided the branch has fulfilled CIT obligations; in practice official approval and tax clearance certification are required before remittance, and a 0.1% foreign contractor tax (FCT) may apply to certain cross-border services or deemed income streams. A Vietnamese LLC's distribution of dividends is exempt from WHT, but dividends received from a Vietnamese subsidiary by the LLC are CIT-exempt at the recipient if the subsidiary is also a Vietnamese enterprise and statutory shareholding conditions are met.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Tax Agreement (DTA), the non-resident recipient must: (1) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the competent tax authority of its residence jurisdiction; (2) submit the TRC and a treaty relief application to the Vietnamese tax authority via the withholding agent or directly before or at the time of payment; (3) provide a written declaration that it is the beneficial owner of the income and meets the limitation-on-benefits or principal-purpose test under the applicable DTA; (4) comply with the procedure under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC regarding the refund mechanism if WHT was already deducted, including filing Form 02/HTBT, a notarized Vietnamese or English translation, and a 60-working-day statutory processing period (extendable in complex cases); (5) ensure the TRC covers the income period and contains sufficient particulars (name, tax ID, period, and competent authority seal). The relevant DTA for Vietnam will typically reduce dividend WHT to 5-15%, interest to 10%, and royalty to 5-10%, but must be examined on a country-by-country basis.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: interest paid by a Vietnamese enterprise to a non-resident lender is subject to Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT), comprising CIT at 5% on the deemed taxable interest income (resulting in a gross WHT-equivalent of 5%) and VAT at 5% (only if the foreign lender has no Vietnam establishment and the service is consumed in Vietnam; for pure loan interest, the VAT element is generally not applied unless the interest is bundled with services; in practice composite FCT rate on interest for a pure loan is often 5% CIT only, but administrative position may treat interest under the 'credit' arrangement at 5% CIT and 5% VAT for a combined 10% if the contract is categorized as a credit service). Cross-border royalties and IP licensing are subject to FCT: CIT rate 10% on deemed taxable royalty income plus VAT 5%, for a combined statutory FCT rate of approximately 15% (calculated on gross royalty under the 'gross-up' method: CIT 10% and VAT 5%, where VAT is computed on the royalty amount excluding VAT). Treaty rates commonly reduce royalty WHT to 10% (e.g., Vietnam-Singapore DTA for certain royalties) or 5-10% depending on the treaty and IP type; interest treaty rates often reduce the 5% statutory CIT to 5% under most DTAs (no further reduction) but the combined VAT-only issue is usually not treaty-relieved because VAT is not within scope of income tax treaties; therefore an interest payment may still bear a combined effective rate of 5% CIT only under a narrow interpretation, or up to 10% if VAT is enforced. The family office must classify intercompany loans, shareholder advances, and IP cost-sharing arrangements carefully to avoid recharacterization.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A taxpayer must prepare a Local File (and, where applicable, a Master File and Country-by-Country Report) if the entity has related-party transactions and the total related-party revenue exceeds VND 50 billion OR total related-party transaction value exceeds VND 30 billion during the tax period. Additionally, a Country-by-Country Report is required for ultimate parent groups with consolidated revenue of VND 18,000 billion or more. Even when the entity does not exceed these thresholds and has no related-party transactions, the annual CIT finalization return must include a declaration of related-party relationships and transactions; Decree 132/2020/ND-CP applies a transaction-by-transaction arm's length analysis and requires contemporaneous documentation within 30 days of a tax authority's request. A single family office with no intercompany transactions still must submit the related-party declaration form (Phụ lục III-B for transactions, or the 'GCNT' annex) and may be required to prove economic substance if it holds assets or receives income from Vietnamese sources.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam has not enacted full OECD-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) like the UAE or BVI, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) under the Law on Tax Administration (Articles 19 and 33), Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC, and the 'substance-over-form' principle allow tax authorities to disregard transactions lacking genuine business purpose. A Vietnamese single-family office LLC must maintain demonstrable substance: a physical office, local management, investment committee meeting minutes, discretion over investment decisions, local employees or properly documented outsourced management agreements, and accounting records explaining the flow of funds. Lack of substance can trigger: (1) recharacterization of intra-group financing as equity or hidden distribution; (2) disallowance of interest and management fee deductions; (3) imposition of FCT on deemed services; (4) CIT reassessment, late-payment interest, and penalties of up to 100% of the additional tax amount for fraud or concealment (under Article 16 of Decree 125/2020/ND-CP) or 10-20% for non-fraud errors and filing mistakes; (5) application of the Controlled Foreign Company rules if applicable in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Tax Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional under-declaration of investment income, off-book securities custody transactions, sham loan agreements with family shareholders to extract cash as deductible interest rather than taxable dividends, backdated loss carryforwards, or use of invoices from shell vendors to inflate deductible expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to 100% of the evaded tax amount under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP Article 16 (for concealment/fraud); an additional fine of VND 3,000,000 to VND 6,000,000 for form violations; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day; criminal prosecution possible under Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) Article 200 for tax evasion: for amounts from VND 100,000,000 or from VND 300,000,000 if the taxpayer has prior tax-sanction convictions, the penalty is a fine of VND 100,000,000 to VND 4,500,000,000 or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years; severe cases involving particularly large amounts and organized schemes can lead to up to 12 years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives, directors, and actual managers who sign false returns or instruct concealment can be jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax, fines, and interest; criminal liability attaches to the legal representative and financial controller; Vietnamese courts apply the 'legal representative presumption' and may impose travel bans, exit visa denials, seizure of personal assets, and imprisonment under Article 200/202 Penal Code; external market-entry restrictions and reputational debarment from serving as legal representative of any Vietnamese company for up to 5 years can follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A single-family-office LLC registered in Vietnam that acts merely as a flow-through vehicle for a foreign family's securities and private investments, has no office, no employees, no local decision-making, no board minutes, no investment policy, and passes all funds and profits to offshore family entities; intercompany management fees paid to a foreign head office without documentation or actual service delivery.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may disallow all related-party expenses and management fees, recharacterize the entity as a foreign-owned permanent establishment, reclassify all income as taxable at the 20% CIT rate, impose a 100% fraud penalty, and charge 0.03% daily late-payment interest; the Ministry of Planning and Investment and tax authorities may cooperate to suspend the enterprise's tax code or revoke the Investment Registration Certificate; under anti-money-laundering law, the State Bank of Vietnam may impose administrative fines on the financial institutions servicing the shell entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders who control the shell may be ordered by a court to pay the corporate tax liabilities out of personal assets under the audited 'enterprise legal personality abuse' doctrine; the director may face a travel ban pending tax debt collection; if the shell is used for money laundering or cross-border financial crime under Penal Code Article 324, directors face imprisonment from 5 to 10 years (or 10 to 15 years in organized/great-value cases) and fines up to VND 100,000,000,000; senior managers of the licensed bank or securities firm serving the family office can also face administrative sanctions for deficient AML/KYC due diligence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and High-Risk Investment Holding Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a private investment holding/family office without filing suspicious transaction reports (STR), failing to identify beneficial owners, receiving large wire transfers from unknown offshore family trusts, conducting transactions with politically exposed persons (PEPs), or using the LLC as a conduit for unapproved cross-border transfers in violation of the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 (effective March 1, 2023) and Decrees 05/2019 and 87/2023.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines for individuals/institutions: up to VND 300,000,000 for reporting violations and up to VND 2,000,000,000 for repeating serious breaches of AML obligations; credit institutions and securities companies may be fined and have their licenses suspended; criminal prosecution for money laundering under Penal Code Article 324: fines up to VND 200,000,000 and imprisonment from 5 to 10 years, or life imprisonment if the offense involves organized crime, international networks, or enormous value (over VND 1,000,000,000,000); violative assets are confiscated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the beneficial owner of the single-family office may be held criminally liable as principals or accomplices; evidence that a director ignored warnings from a compliance officer intensifies liability by 50% under the Law on AML; travel bans, seizure of passports, and prohibitions on leaving Vietnam are standard investigative measures; civil liability extends to restitution of laundered funds and damages to third-party investors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Undercase Registration or Unlicensed Investment Activities (Cross-Border Regulatory Violation)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A single-family-office LLC conducting regular public offers of securities, managing third-party assets, acting as a de facto collective investment scheme, or providing discretionary portfolio management to persons outside the family group without a securities license from the State Securities Commission of Vietnam (SSC), despite the nominal 'private family office' characterization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: If the activity is deemed a securities/investment service, the enterprise can be subject to administrative fines from VND 100,000,000 up to VND 500,000,000 under Decree 128/2021/ND-CP and orders to cease operations; income from such unlicensed activity is fully taxable and may be deemed a source of criminal tax fraud; the SSC may report the violation to the Minister of Finance for criminal prosecution if thresholds apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who engage in unlicensed regulated activity face criminal liability for operating a securities firm without a license under Penal Code Article 209 (illegal business) with fines or imprisonment up to 5 years; they are jointly responsible for refunding investor losses; the family's reputational exposure and the legal representative's suspension from company management functions are consequential.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual CIT Finalization and Related-Party Tax Disclosure (Procedural Failure)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to submit the annual CIT return Form 03/TNDN, omitting required schedules for transactions with related parties (including a zero-return where intercompany relationships still exist), and neglecting to submit the country-by-country report or master file within statutory deadlines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed fines graduated by severity: VND 4,000,000-8,000,000 for late filing up to 90 days (depending on number of articles), over 90 days: VND 15,000,000-25,000,000 plus 0.03% daily interest on the unpaid tax; failure to provide documentation upon request can trigger a re-assessment based on the tax authority's unilateral recharacterization, plus a 20% penalty on the under-declared amount; repeated violations may result in enterprise code suspension, cancellation of the tax registration, and forced revenue deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative is personally liable for administrative fines that remain unpaid after the corporate assets are exhausted; Vietnamese writ-of-execution law allows the enforcement agency to place the legal representative on a no-exit list, temporarily suspend business activities, and confiscate personal motor vehicles, bank accounts, and real property to satisfy the debt.
